# Vivek Anand

> Personal site of Vivek Anand, from Kerai, a village in Bihar, India. Software engineering is part of his life alongside cricket and table tennis.

Vivek's current role is remote, so for now he works from home in Kerai. Professionally, he is a product engineer with roots in backend development. He works across the product lifecycle (product thinking, design, frontend and backend) and leads the teams that ship it, most recently at Barq and Virtual Internships.

## Personal site

- [About](https://anandvivek.in/): Personal background, interests, education, and contact details.
